description.value: Beijing Bistro is a Chinese restaurant on Victoria's Fort Street serving dine-in, takeout, and delivery. Located in the heart of the city, it offers a convenient stop for touring cyclists exploring downtown Victoria. The restaurant is closed Tuesdays and offers delivery through DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Fantuan.
